design.anti_collapse_gate: per exam form each class recall >= .5 and opposite-label ranking AUC >= .7
design.equal_work: same optimizer trial and model train/gate token counts, not wall time
design.gate_policy: parent-correct item mask, new gate loss <= parent, geometry; not monotonic loss
design.replay_source: rule-verified examples plus newly admitted exact-source numeric-copy exercises, not raw document training

limits: Different templates and seeds from R1.12; no causal proof of collapse removal
Random CE leads, both balanced arms each lose one old item
